review.assessment: This change adds `crm/keys.py`, introducing a folding utility and a merge key function intended to canonicalize email-based identity resolution. However, `merge_key` returns the raw email string instead of calling `fold_email`, so the canonicalization logic is effectively disabled at the point of merging. Because no other files were updated in this diff to consume `fold_email` or replace their current raw-key lookups, downstream duplicate customers will continue to be created on casing/whitespace differences.

findings.call: python -c "from crm.keys import merge_key; print(repr(merge_key({'email': ' A@b.com '})))"
findings.defect: `merge_key` fails to apply email folding, defeating the purpose of the new module and leaving the duplicate customer bug unaddressed when this key is used for merging.
